reply.text: This is a pain question, so it's one for a doctor or physio, not a coach. I can't tell you what the ache is or whether it's safe to keep loading it. Get it looked at, and once they've given you the go-ahead, tell me what they cleared and I'll train around it. In the meantime I can keep the week on the training side: if you want to step off the barbell this week, tell me which sessions are affected and I'll adjust them with you.
